title: reading first: do list_objects and describe_object return the descriptions an author wrote on objects and fields
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this seat's chat, 2026-11-17. On the synonyms layer, verbatim: 「同意，所以hotcrm 也需要立卡改进对吧」, answering the seat's three-layer proposal (authors write synonyms; the server hints on a zero-match; the client asks back). In the same chat the maintainer agreed not to add synonyms to objects and fields; this card is what that layer needs instead.

## Why

When no governed metric answers a question, the client falls back to the object tools and has to pick an object and fields by reading what the tools return. If an author wrote "amount, tax excluded" on a field and the tool does not return it, the client guesses.

Who acts: a read-only reading first (server lane, `packages/mcp`). Who reads the result: every MCP client on the fallback path.

## Evidence (objectstack `a0326b06`, read 2026-11-17; descriptions read, results not conclusively checked)

- `list_objects` describes itself as returning "each object's name, label and field count" (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts:2526`).
- `describe_object` describes each field as name, type, label, required, readonly, system, options, defaultValue (`:2584`). Neither description names a description or help text.

## Scope

- Reading: on `examples/app-crm`, call both tools for an object and a field that carry a `description`, and record what comes back.
- If absent: return the object's and the field's existing `description`, under the caller's field-level security, with the byte cost stated. No new metadata key.

## Done when

- The reading is on this card; if a change follows, a pin shows the description returned for a readable field and withheld for an unreadable one.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Related: #33824 (labels beside raw values).
- Dedup, open and closed: no query run beyond the parent's; the lane dedups on first touch.
